note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1967. The Richhill contest and the unopposed return in Killyman are filed. The Belfast Telegraph (17 May 1967, p. 4) reports that Francis J. McOscar, the sitting member for Charlemont, was opposed by a former councillor, Patrick Fox, but no Charlemont result was found (the results printed on 2 June name only Richhill, and McOscar sat on the council afterwards), so Charlemont is not filed. The members returned unopposed in the other divisions are not named in the reports read. Returned unopposed. "Consequent upon the retirement of Mr. R. A. Abraham ... from Armagh Rural District Council after more than thirty years service, Mr. Ernest William Charles Weir has been returned unopposed in his place"; nominated by Francis H. Hays, seconded by James A. Graham. The report does not name the division: Abraham was the member for Killyman (1936-1964), and the district it describes (Derryane, Vernersbridge, Derryadd) lies in it.
